name: FA complementation group M

function.text: FANCM encodes fanconi anemia group M protein. Annotated molecular activities include ATP hydrolysis activity and RNA helicase activity. It participates in interstrand cross-link repair and replication fork processing.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include FANCM Fanconi-like genomic instability disorder (autosomal recessive); spermatogenic failure 28 (autosomal recessive). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.
